description: Returns the documented upstream API response directly without an additional wrapper.

fields.name: errcode
fields.description: Gateway response code, 200 indicates success.

fields.name: errmsg
fields.description: Gateway status or error message.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Business response code for the list endpoint.

fields.name: msg
fields.description: Business message for the list endpoint.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Number of news items returned by the list endpoint.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Render style returned by the upstream endpoint.

fields.name: data
fields.description: News list returned by the policy feed endpoint.

fields.name: data[].id
fields.description: News record ID used to fetch the full body.

fields.name: data[].title
fields.description: News title in the list response.

fields.name: data[].summaryZh
fields.description: AI-generated Chinese summary for the news item.

fields.name: data[].originalUrl
fields.description: Original article URL.

fields.name: data[].publishedAt
fields.description: Publication or change time, format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

fields.name: stdout
fields.description: Full news body in Markdown format returned by the detail endpoint.

fields.name: title
fields.description: News title returned by the detail endpoint.

fields.name: summaryZh
fields.description: AI-generated Chinese summary returned by the detail endpoint.

fields.name: costTime
fields.description: Total processing time in milliseconds.

fields.name: costToken
fields.description: Token consumption.

fields.name: columns
fields.description: Frontend column definitions returned by the list endpoint.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Provider-specific message.

fields.name: sourceType
fields.description: Provider-specific source platform type.

fields.name: sourceTool
fields.description: Provider-specific source tool name.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Page size returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageItemCount
fields.description: Item count on the current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: totalPage
fields.description: Total page count returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: dataSnapshotMonth
fields.description: Data snapshot month returned by the upstream provider.
